title: Summarize a list of likes
summary: Produce a grammatically correct message describing who liked an item.
requirements: Use exactly the shown singular/plural wording.
For four or more names, show the first two names and the number of others.
hints: Handle list lengths zero through three explicitly.
For longer lists, the other count is length minus two.

tests.name: Edge case — [["Max","John","Mark"]]
tests.expected: Max, John and Mark like this

tests.name: Additional variation — [["Alex","Jacob","Mark","Max"]]
tests.expected: Alex, Jacob and 2 others like this
